title: Get Started

seo.meta_description: Tell us what you need help with, then send a short request to Reliance Consulting in Tampa.

_about: Proposed page: written for the redesign, not crawled. Design-free module instances in the same format as content/structured. `page` keys name a live crawl slug or another proposed page; `href` is the new-site URL. Facts that came from the crawl are in `verified`; new wording and anything the crawl cannot show is in `confirm`. Intake flow, native Squarespace: step 1 is a page of choice cards, step 2 is one page per choice with its own Form block, step 3 is the form's post-submit page.
verified: Tier names and the three tier pages: PROJECT_PLAN section 2 (confirmed with Thom 2026-11-03)
Client portal and mobile app pages: live /reliance-consulting-netclient-portals and /app
confirm: Page copy: 'What do you need help with?', 'Step 1 of 2' / 'Step 2 of 2', 'Change', 'Send my request', the five choice cards and their lines (new copy; the plan's choices are tiers, existing client, not sure)
Disclaimer under every form: "Please do not send Social Security numbers or account details through this form." (new wording; the live privacy policy is the only related text)
Contact fields on every form: Name, Email, Phone, 'How should we reach you?' (Call / Email), 'Anything else we should know?'; Name, Email and the contact method are required
Cynthia: who actually receives a new lead today and by which inbox; each form should email that person (Squarespace forms can route per form, so four forms = four inboxes if wanted)
Cynthia: which questions the tax team wishes prospects answered up front; the questions below are placeholders
Cynthia: privacy limits for financial-prospect data, and whether there is a scheduling tool to link
Squarespace Form blocks cannot show or hide questions, so each choice has its own page and form; the native form's post-submit redirect goes to the thanks page

slots.title: What do you need help with?
slots.text: Choose the one that fits best. We will ask only what matters for it.

cards.title: I need my taxes done or a tax problem solved.
cards.text: Returns, tax planning, or help with the IRS.

cards.title: I need help keeping my business's books.
cards.text: Bookkeeping, QuickBooks, payroll and cash flow.

cards.title: I am starting, running or planning for a business.
cards.text: Business plans, financing, financial planning and advice.

cards.title: I am already a client.
cards.text: Log in to the client portal or get the mobile app.

cards.title: I am not sure.
cards.text: Tell us a little and we will point you in the right direction.
